subject: Insurance
title: Upcoding: Charging for Premium Care
description: A quick win: understand Upcoding: Charging for Premium Care.

hook.text: A doctor treats a cold but bills it as pneumonia. The code changes from $100 to $1,500.

buildup.text: Medical billing uses thousands of codes. Changing one digit can multiply the reimbursement.

discovery.text: AI now scans millions of claims for upcoding patterns.

twist.text: Upcoding isn't always intentional. Complex billing rules lead to honest errors too.

climax.text: Upcoding bleeds billions from the insurance system.

punchline.text: Cold billed as pneumonia. One code change costs insurers 15x more.

quiz.question: What is upcoding?
options: Billing for a more expensive procedure than performed
